verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ َقَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ עַל־דִּגְלֹ֤ו בְאֹתֹת֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִנֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְאֹֽהֶל־מֹועֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.ar: «يَنْزِلُ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ كُلٌّ عِنْدَ رَايَتِهِ بِأَعْلَامٍ لِبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ. قُبَالَةَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ حَوْلَهَا يَنْزِلُونَ.
verses.en: 'The children of Israel shall pitch by their fathers' houses; every man with his own standard, according to the ensigns; a good way off shall they pitch round about the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.web: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

verses.he: וְהַחֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשֹׁ֖ון בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.ar: فَٱلنَّازِلُونَ إِلَى ٱلشَّرْقِ، نَحْوَ ٱلشُّرُوقِ، رَايَةُ مَحَلَّةِ يَهُوذَا حَسَبَ أَجْنَادِهِمْ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي يَهُوذَا نَحْشُونُ بْنُ عَمِّينَادَابَ،
verses.en: Now those that pitch on the east side toward the sunrising shall be they of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Judah being Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
verses.kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab [shall be] captain of the children of Judah.
verses.web: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَسَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا وَسِتُّ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

verses.he: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّازِلُونَ مَعَهُ سِبْطُ يَسَّاكَرَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي يَسَّاكَرَ نَثَنَائِيلُ بْنُ صُوغَرَ،
verses.en: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar; the prince of the children of Issachar being Nethanel the son of Zuar,
verses.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him [shall be] the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar [shall be] captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדָ֑יו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃ ס
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty and four thousand and four hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

verses.he: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.ar: وَسِبْطُ زَبُولُونَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي زَبُولُونَ أَلِيآبُ بْنُ حِيلُونَ،
verses.en: and the tribe of Zebulun; the prince of the children of Zebulun being Eliab the son of Helon,
verses.kjv: [Then] the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon [shall be] captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.web: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُ سَبْعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered thereof, fifty and seven thousand and four hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

verses.he: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאֹ֖ות לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃ ס
verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ لِمَحَلَّةِ يَهُوذَا مِئَةُ أَلْفٍ وَسِتَّةٌ وَثَمَانُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ بِأَجْنَادِهِمْ. يَرْتَحِلُونَ أَوَّلًا.
verses.en: all that were numbered of the camp of Judah being a hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their hosts; they shall set forth first.
verses.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah [were] an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

verses.he: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.ar: «رَايَةُ مَحَلَّةِ رَأُوبَيْنَ إِلَى ٱلتَّيْمَنِ حَسَبَ أَجْنَادِهِمْ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي رَأُوبَيْنَ أَلِيصُورُ بْنُ شَدَيْئُورَ،
verses.en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Reuben being Elizur the son of Shedeur,
verses.kjv: ¶ On the south side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben [shall be] Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.web: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُ سِتَّةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا وَخَمْسُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered thereof, forty and six thousand and five hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.he: וְהַחֹונִ֥ם עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְעֹ֑ון וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעֹ֔ון שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽי־שַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّازِلُونَ مَعَهُ سِبْطُ شِمْعُونَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي شِمْعُونَ شَلُومِيئِيلُ بْنُ صُورِيشَدَّاي،
verses.en: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Simeon; the prince of the children of Simeon being Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,
verses.kjv: And those which pitch by him [shall be] the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon [shall be] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ تِسْعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and nine thousand and three hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.he: וְמַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־רְעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَسِبْطُ جَادَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي جَادْ أَلِيَاسَافُ بْنُ رَعُوئِيلَ،
verses.en: and the tribe of Gad; the prince of the children of Gad being Eliasaph the son of Reuel,
verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.web: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ خَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا وَسِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.en: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

verses.he: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְאֶחָ֨ד וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאֹ֥ות וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ׃ ס
verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ لِمَحَلَّةِ رَأُوبَيْنَ مِئَةُ أَلْفٍ وَوَاحِدٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسُونَ بِأَجْنَادِهِمْ، وَيَرْتَحِلُونَ ثَانِيَةً.
verses.en: all that were numbered of the camp of Reuben being a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts; and they shall set forth second.
verses.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

verses.he: וְנָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל־מֹועֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּתֹ֣וךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־יָדֹ֖ו לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ ס
verses.ar: «ثُمَّ تَرْتَحِلُ خَيْمَةُ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ. مَحَلَّةُ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْمَحَلَّاتِ. كَمَا يَنْزِلُونَ كَذَلِكَ يَرْتَحِلُونَ. كُلٌّ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ بِرَايَاتِهِمْ.
verses.en: Then the tent of meeting, with the camp of the Levites, shall set forward in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place, by their standards.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.web: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

verses.he: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם יָ֑מָּה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.ar: «رَايَةُ مَحَلَّةِ أَفْرَايِمَ حَسَبَ أَجْنَادِهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْغَرْبِ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي أَفْرَايِمَ أَلِيشَمَعُ بْنُ عَمِّيهُودَ،
verses.en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Ephraim being Elishama the son of Ammihud,
verses.kjv: ¶ On the west side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim [shall be] Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.web: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ أَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا وَخَمْسُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

verses.he: וְעָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.ar: وَمَعَهُ سِبْطُ مَنَسَّى، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي مَنَسَّى جَمْلِيئِيلُ بْنُ فَدَهْصُورَ،
verses.en: and next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; the prince of the children of Manasseh being Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur,
verses.kjv: And by him [shall be] the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh [shall be] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.web: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمُ ٱثْنَانِ وَثَلَاثُونَ أَلْفًا وَمِئَتَانِ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and two hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.he: וּמַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَسِبْطُ بَنْيَامِينَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي بَنْيَامِينَ أَبِيدَنُ بْنُ جِدْعُونِي،
verses.en: and the tribe of Benjamin; the prince of the children of Benjamin being Abidan the son of Gideoni,
verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin [shall be] Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.web: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and five thousand and four hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.web: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.he: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁמֹֽנַת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ׃ ס
verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ لِمَحَلَّةِ أَفْرَايِمَ مِئَةُ أَلْفٍ وَثَمَانِيَةُ آلَافٍ وَمِئَةٌ بِأَجْنَادِهِمْ، وَيَرْتَحِلُونَ ثَالِثَةً.
verses.en: all that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim being a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts; and they shall set forth third.
verses.kjv: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim [were] an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

verses.he: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.ar: «رَايَةُ مَحَلَّةِ دَانَ إِلَى ٱلشِّمَالِ حَسَبَ أَجْنَادِهِمْ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي دَانَ أَخِيعَزَرُ بْنُ عَمِّيشَدَّاي،
verses.en: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Dan being Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai,
verses.kjv: ¶ The standard of the camp of Dan [shall be] on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan [shall be] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.web: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمُ ٱثْنَانِ وَسِتُّونَ أَلْفًا وَسَبْعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and two thousand and seven hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.he: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّازِلُونَ مَعَهُ سِبْطُ أَشِيرَ، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي أَشِيرَ فَجْعِيئِيلُ بْنُ عُكْرَنَ،
verses.en: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher; the prince of the children of Asher being Pagiel the son of Ochran,
verses.kjv: And those that encamp by him [shall be] the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher [shall be] Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا وَخَمْسُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty and one thousand and five hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.he: וּמַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.ar: وَسِبْطُ نَفْتَالِي، وَٱلرَّئِيسُ لِبَنِي نَفْتَالِي أَخِيرَعُ بْنُ عِينَنَ،
verses.en: and the tribe of Naphtali; the prince of the children of Naphtali being Ahira the son of Enan,
verses.kjv: ¶ Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali [shall be] Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.web: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.he: וּצְבָאֹ֖ו וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَجُنْدُهُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ ثَلَاثَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred;
verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.he: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵאֹ֑ות לָאַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ لِمَحَلَّةِ دَانَ مِئَةُ أَلْفٍ وَسَبْعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَسِتُّ مِئَةٍ. يَرْتَحِلُونَ أَخِيرًا بِرَايَاتِهِمْ».
verses.en: all that were numbered of the camp of Dan being a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred; they shall set forth hindmost by their standards.'
verses.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

verses.he: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽמַּחֲנֹת֙ לְצִבְאֹתָ֔ם שֵׁשׁ־מֵאֹ֥ות אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ هُمُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ حَسَبَ بُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ. جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحَلَّاتِ بِأَجْنَادِهِمْ سِتُّ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ وَثَلَاثَةُ آلَافٍ وَخَمْسُ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.en: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses; all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.kjv: ¶ These [are] those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts [were] six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.he: וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּתֹ֖וךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ فَلَمْ يُعَدُّوا بَيْنَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וֽ͏ַיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן־חָנ֤וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם֙ וְכֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖יו עַל־בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَفَعَلَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى. هَكَذَا نَزَلُوا بِرَايَاتِهِمْ، وَهَكَذَا ٱرْتَحَلُوا. كُلٌّ حَسَبَ عَشَائِرِهِ مَعَ بَيْتِ آبَائِهِ.
verses.en: Thus did the children of Israel: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, each one according to its families, and according to its fathers' houses.
verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
